1: // Neon Runner – simple infinite runner using the canvas with id="game"
2: // Controls: Arrow Up (jump), Arrow Down (slide)
3: // The player is a rectangle; obstacles are simple rectangles.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   // Set canvas size to fill the window
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
15:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
16:   };
17:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
18:   resize();
19: 
20:   // Game constants
21:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
22:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
23:   const SLIDE_TIME = 500; // ms
24:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 6;
25:   const OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
26: 
27:   // Player state
28:   const player = {
29:     width: 40,
30:     height: 80,
31:     x: 100,
32:     y: 0,
33:     vy: 0,
34:     onGround: false,
35:     sliding: false,
36:     slideTimer: 0,
37:     color: '#0ff',
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Obstacles array
41:   const obstacles = [];
42: 
43:   // Helper to create obstacle
44:   function spawnObstacle() {
45:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'low' : 'high'; // low: requires jump, high: requires slide
46:     const width = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
47:     const height = type === 'low' ? 30 : 120;
48:     const y = type === 'low' ? canvas.height - height : canvas.height - player.height - 20; // high obstacle placed where player would hit if not sliding
49:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width + width, y, width, height, type, passed: false });
50:   }
51: 
52:   // Input handling
53:   const keys = {};
54:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
55:     keys[e.code] = true;
56:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' && player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
57:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
58:       player.onGround = false;
59:     }
60:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' && !player.sliding && player.onGround) {
61:       player.sliding = true;
62:       player.slideTimer = SLIDE_TIME;
63:       // Reduce height while sliding
64:       player.height = 40;
65:     }
66:   });
67:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
68:     keys[e.code] = false;
69:   });
70: 
71:   let lastTime = 0;
72:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
73:   let score = 0;
74:   let gameOver = false;
75: 
76:   function update(dt) {
77:     if (gameOver) return;
78:     // Player physics
79:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
80:     player.y += player.vy;
81:     // ground check
82:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.height;
83:     if (player.y >= groundY) {
84:       player.y = groundY;
85:       player.vy = 0;
86:       player.onGround = true;
87:     }
88:     // Slide timer
89:     if (player.sliding) {
90:       player.slideTimer -= dt;
91:       if (player.slideTimer <= 0) {
92:         player.sliding = false;
93:         player.height = 80; // restore height
94:       }
95:     }
96:     // Obstacles
97:     obstacleTimer += dt;
98:     if (obstacleTimer >= OBSTACLE_INTERVAL) {
99:       obstacleTimer = 0;
100:       spawnObstacle();
101:     }
102:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
103:       const o = obstacles[i];
104:       o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
105:       // Collision detection (simple AABB)
106:       if (!o.passed &&
107:           player.x < o.x + o.width &&
108:           player.x + player.width > o.x &&
109:           player.y < o.y + o.height &&
110:           player.y + player.height > o.y) {
111:         // Collision – game over
112:         gameOver = true;
113:       }
114:       // Score when passing obstacle
115:       if (!o.passed && o.x + o.width < player.x) {
116:         o.passed = true;
117:         score++;
118:       }
119:       // Remove off‑screen
120:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) {
121:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
122:       }
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   function render() {
127:     // Clear background (dark neon)
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
129:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
130:     // Draw player
131:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
132:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
133:     // Draw obstacles
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
135:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
136:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
137:     });
138:     // Draw score
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
140:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
141:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 30);
142:     // Game over overlay
143:     if (gameOver) {
144:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
145:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
146:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f55';
147:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
148:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
149:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
150:     }
151:   }
152: 
153:   function loop(timestamp) {
154:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
155:     lastTime = timestamp;
156:     update(dt);
157:     render();
158:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
159:   }
160: 
161:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162: })();

(End of file - total 162 lines)
